name: Challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk
summary: Overlord Mok'Morokk scoffs at your challenge, promises to crush you and invites you to say when you are ready to be thrashed. Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village had hoped to see Mok'Morokk driven out of the village.

sections.title: A Challenge to the Overlord
sections.body: You step up to Overlord Mok'Morokk, who laughs at your nerve, promises to crush you and tells you to speak up when you are ready for your beating. This follows The Brood of Onyxia. Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village expects to see Mok'Morokk chased from the village, and wonders why you would come back just to talk.

sections.title: Word for Draz'Zilb
sections.body: Once the fight is won, Draz'Zilb says Mok'Morokk ran off like a coward, and thanks you for a great service. With Mok'Morokk gone, the ogres can name a new leader who will aid them in taking back their old home for good.

faq.answer: You challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village. The Overlord answers with a laugh and a boast of crushing you.
It follows The Brood of Onyxia.

faq.q: Who do you report to after the fight?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
where to go after beating mok'morokk
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village is the one to report to.

faq.q: What does Draz'Zilb expect of you?
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb expects to see Mok'Morokk chased from the village, and wonders why you would come back just to talk.
